title: Punch Shot Low Under The Wind (Chas McIvor)
style: country swing bluegrass banjo brass bongo fast beat 130bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections southern drawl mandolin steel guitar
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
I say son, when the wind howls
Go low under it, dont fight it
Punch shot is the trouble club

[Verse 1]
Ball back of center three inches, hands forward four
Weight seventy thirty lead side, more more
Grip down the shaft an inch, choke up tight
Three quarter swing, abbreviated and right

[Pre-Chorus]
Low follow through, finish at the belt
Dont release the wrists, dont let them melt
Knock the ball down low, knee high flight
Twenty yards short of stock, son, thats right

[Chorus]
Punch shot low under the wind, son
Knee high flight, the work begun
Ball back, hands forward, three quarter swing
Finish at the belt, the low ball sing

[Verse 2]
Use it under tree branches, low ceiling shot
Use it into the wind, take the spin out a lot
Use it for trouble recovery, bump and run
Three clubs more than normal, the low knockdown

[Bridge - Chas spoken]
I say boy, the punch shot saves rounds
Under the trees, in the wind, on hard grounds
Knee high, belt high finish, control is king
Learn the punch shot, son, every round it will sing

[Chorus]
Punch shot low under the wind, son
Knee high flight, the work begun
Ball back, hands forward, three quarter swing
Finish at the belt, the low ball sing

[Outro]
Ball back, hands ahead
Three quarter swing, low instead
Belt high finish, no release
Thats my boy, thats your peace
